description: React hook implementation for Minesweeper game logic, including grid management, mine placement, flood reveal, and game state handling.

methods.name: keyOf
methods.description: Creates a deterministic string key for a cell based on row and column indices.

methods.name: cloneGrid
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the grid to avoid mutation bugs.

methods.name: getNeighbors
methods.description: Returns the coordinates of all 8 neighboring cells around a given cell.

methods.name: createEmptyGrid
methods.description: Builds an initial empty grid with no mines.

methods.name: placeMinesAndComputeCounts
methods.description: Randomly places mines excluding the first click and its neighbors, then computes adjacent mine counts.

methods.name: floodReveal
methods.description: Reveals cells using flood-fill starting from an empty cell.

methods.name: revealAllMines
methods.description: Reveals all mines on the grid, typically when the game is lost.
